items.en_title: Santo Antônio do Retiro (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #19
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Santo Antônio do Retiro (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 6,347,183.31; proposals close Nov 19, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
